statement:
I'll pull up the recurring payment record first.
The record shows RP-88 is a USD 1,188.00 annual renewal to Fitline Health Club scheduled for tomorrow, still flagged as an active renewing membership against a balance of USD 240.00 — which conflicts with the cancellation Fitline confirmed to Tomas in writing on 3 July.

I've refused the charge. The cancellation was confirmed by the club, so no renewal should be taken, and the payment would also have exceeded the account balance.

One note: Fitline's own system still shows the membership as active and renewing. Tomas may want to follow up with them to make sure their records reflect the cancellation, so a similar charge isn't attempted again.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer states the record's "active, renewing" status and charge "conflicts with the cancellation Fitline confirmed" and that "no renewal should be taken," also noting it "would have exceeded the account balance."
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
